title: Between-participant variability in matched-load HIFT: Reproducibility package
description: Reproducibility package for a Bayesian secondary analysis of between-participant variability in perceptual and physiological responses to matched-load high-intensity functional training. Version 1.1.0 adds relaxed-primary analyses, likelihood and prior power-scaling, revised posterior predictions and posterior-predictive checks, and an observed-scale analogue of the ordinal RPE variance partition coefficient.
